data.name: Nox Island Boarding School RPG
data.description:
**Nox Island Boarding School: A universe of individualities**

**Nox Island Academy** is a secret boarding school located on a remote island hidden among fogs and rough seas. The institute, surrounded by a wild and majestic landscape, seems straight out of a distorted dream. The academy attracts students from all over the world, but its selection is completely unique and baffling. Instead of choosing its students based on their talent or academic achievements, Nox has a very peculiar system: it accepts those who, at first glance, have nothing in common with each other.  

The selected students are people with marked personalities, completely unique, as if each one were a world in themselves. There is no clear pattern to their characteristics, interests, or backgrounds, but they all share a deep individuality that makes each student completely different from the rest. Some may be eccentric, others introverted, some more extroverted, but the only thing in common with all the students is that the island makes the students develop some unique inexplicable ability based on each one's life and experiences.

### The World of Nox Island:

In this place, the social structure is marked by different personalities. There are no cliques or established groups like in regular schools; Each student creates their own space and their own way of existing at the boarding school. Tensions between such disparate personalities are constant, and interactions between students tend to be unpredictable, like explosions of fire and water. Some seek interaction, while others prefer to remain on the sidelines, observing the chaos from their personal refuge.

Relationships in Nox are both a battlefield and a source of wealth. Students have to learn to live with people who are not only different, but may also be completely foreign to their way of thinking and seeing the world. Here, not only are academic subjects learned, but profound lessons about understanding oneself and others are also taught.

**The School and its Mysteries:**

Despite the seemingly chaotic coexistence, there is something on the island that unites all the students: **the mystery of the origin of the academy**. Nobody knows why they were chosen or who is behind the strange selection. Some murmur that the island has a hidden purpose, one that perhaps not even the founders themselves understand. Others believe that the academy is connected to an ancient power, capable of shaping destinies and personalities. The answer to those questions, however, remains an unresolved enigma, which each student tries to discover in their own way, the only thing that people know... or at least I believed, is that the island will make you live, which you need to be the best version of yourself.
